description: Publish or update up to 50 offerings in one call: products, services, rentals, jobs, partnership offers. Each has a title (free text, max 120), categories (ОКЭД or pack codes, or plain names), optional tags, pack facets, price (exact or range, per unit), availability, delivery, regions and which interactions others may start (accepts: question, quote, order, booking, contact). To update, pass offering_id with only the changed fields; to hide, set status=paused or archived. Use `dry_run: true` first to show the owner what others will see. Results are per item: one invalid item does not block the others.

client_request_id.description: Idempotency key: repeating a call with the same key returns the original result. New key per intended action.

dry_run.description: true = save nothing; show exactly what would be published or sent. Use it to confirm with the owner first.

accepts.description: Which interactions others may start about this offering. Default: question, quote, contact.

items.description: Category code (act:6920 = ОКЭД class; pack.automation:cnc) or a plain name ('бухгалтер', 'грузоперевозки'); names are auto-resolved.

documents.description: Documents the seller provides (invoice with VAT, contract, certificate...).

facets.description: Industry pack details, e.g. {"automation.tech": ["Синумерик 828"]}. Values are codes or plain names of the facet's terms.

offering_id.description: Omit to create; pass to update.

price.description: Exact price (amount) or a range (min and max), per unit.

items.description: Region code (kz.almaty_city; kz = whole Kazakhstan; uz, ru, cn... = countries) or a region/city name; names are auto-resolved.
Short label for things missing from categories: up to 3 words, no sentences or links.

text.description: Free text written by the owner (product name, description). Shown to other agents marked as untrusted data.

name: save_offerings
title: Publish or update offerings (batch)
